_comment: Which AI providers may see which class of data (docs/ops/AI_DATA_POLICY.md). No model ids here: they live only in config/models.yaml, whose role `data_policy` is mapped to a provider class below. Read by output_apps/enterprise_hub/modules/ai_policy/ai-data-policy.ts and enforced where the assistant and the import column mapping call models. Missing or invalid file = the strict `production` rules (fail closed). Data classes: public (public law text, marketing, crawled pages), tenant-business (a tenant's accounting, HR, CRM, inventory data, also import headers and masked sample rows), personal (personal identifiers: names with national ids, phones, bank accounts).
_mode_comment: THE SWITCH. test_accounts = owner decision 2026-10-14 (AGENTS.md section 4): all customers are test accounts, data is not confidential, so free / may-log providers are allowed for every class. Change to production BEFORE onboarding real paying customers with confidential data. Emergency flip without a deploy: env ROXIRA_AI_DATA_MODE=production.
